evals.prompt: Review this migration but do not modify files or the database
assertions: stays read-only: no file writes, no migration applied
checks history order, checksums, locks and rollback or forward-only behavior
reports risks with file and line

evals.prompt: Add a nullable column to the conversations table
assertions: writes a new numbered migration instead of editing an applied one
uses an isolated fixture database, never a shared one
adds a test and states fixture versus real-service evidence separately

evals.prompt: Make usage reservations release on failure
assertions: names the transaction boundary that owns the reservation
adds a concurrency or failure-path test
does not delete volumes or touch shared services
